title: azalea × mortieri
intro: Azalea × mortieri, commonly known as Rhododendron ponticum, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the heath family and is native to Western Asia and Eastern Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high antioxidant content. The bioactive constituents present in Rhododendron ponticum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron ponticum also make it a potential candidate for further research in the development of new medications and treatments.
